errors.text_span: with tick marks spaced at intervals of 10⁻⁵
errors.evidence: The vertical axis is logarithmic, so the tick marks are not spaced at regular linear intervals. The major grid lines shown are at 10⁻⁵ and 10⁻⁴.

errors.text_span: The chart displays sets of paired bars for each Block Index value
errors.evidence: The chart does not display paired bars. For each Block Index, there is a single bar, which is either blue (4-Fbit) or green (2-Fbit).
The bar for Block Index 0 has a sensitivity value just below 10⁻⁵, approximately 8 x 10⁻⁶ or 9 x 10⁻⁶, not 3 x 10⁻⁶.

errors.text_span: “4-Fbit” bars begin to appear at block index 31
errors.evidence: The first blue ('4-Fbit') bar appears at block index 27, not 31.

The tallest bar at index 63 reaches a sensitivity of approximately 2 x 10⁻⁴. The value 9 x 10⁻⁴ is a significant overestimation, as it is close to the next major log tick (10⁻³) which is far off the scale.

errors.text_span: The tallest “2-Fbit” bar, located at Block Index 47
errors.evidence: The bar at Block Index 47 is blue ('4-Fbit'), not green ('2-Fbit'). The tallest green bar appears at a different index (e.g., around index 26).
The description fails to mention the general increasing trend of sensitivity with the block index, which is a key feature of the data.
